comment: Estimate governance + procurement constants (phase E2). The estimate state machine, register statuses/transitions, default actor and quote date-math knobs live here; nothing is hard-coded in romtool/governance.py. binding math: binding_until is INCLUSIVE (a quote stays binding through that date, expires strictly after).

estimate_state_comments.review->draft: sent back for re-pricing (rejected in review)
estimate_state_comments.approved->superseded: withdrawn without sending; supersedes in place

revision_note: PATCH /estimates/{id} creates revision N+1 only while state is in states_allowing_revision; approved/sent/superseded estimates are frozen (409).
assumption_note: open -> verified (norm confirmed against source/quote), verified -> closed (close-out accepted), verified -> open (verification rejected, reopened). Skipped steps are rejected with 409.
auto_assumption_note: On every compute/revision, each estimate line whose line kind carries a labor norm (catalog row kind 'minutes') and whose unit card is auto_assumption_source_quality-flagged auto-populates one register row (estimate_id, catalog_id, line_key, text from item+reference, owner default, status open). 0-minute quote/cost-carry rows are procurement items, not norms - they surface in the quote register instead.
quote_note: draft -> received (vendor number in), received -> bound (commitment), -> expired (binding lapsed or vendor withdrew); expired -> received re-issues a corrected quote. Effective status: stored received/bound rows flip to 'expired' automatically the day AFTER binding_until.
bid_tab_note: low/mid/high of a scope group use only quotes whose effective status is in bid_tab_quote_statuses (drafts are placeholders, expired numbers are stale); mid is the median amount, ordering is ascending by amount.
sanity_blocks_note: Phase E4 guard: when transitioning into a sanity_block_states state, the estimate's sanity report (GET /estimates/{id}/sanity) is recomputed on demand; any HARD finding (missing archetype checklist scope, crew duration math inconsistency) rejects the transition with 409 and lists the findings. Warnings (labor-share, E-density, unit-cost outliers, quote expiry) never block. Set sanity_blocks_approval false to disable.
